CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportPieczatki] @RowVersion BIGINT, @PointOfSaleId INT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; select 0 as [@RowVersion], ( select Frm_GidNumer as [@Id], Frm_Nazwa1 as [@CompanyName], --as [@LegalForm], --as [@SubsidiaryName], Frm_NIP as [@CompanyTIN], Frm_Regon as [@CompanyEIN], --as [@Industry], --as [@IndustryCode], Frm_DOrganRej as [@RegisteringAuthority], Frm_DNazwaRej as [@RegistryName], Frm_DNumerRej as [@NumberInRegistry], case when Frm_DDataRej = 0 then null else DateAdd(d,Frm_DDataRej,convert(datetime,'28-12-1800',105)) end as [@RegistrationDate], Frm_DKapitalZakladowy as [@ShareCapital], WanID as [@ShareCapitalCurrencyId], Frm_DKapitalWplacony as [@PaidInCapital], (select top 1 WaN_Id from cdn.walnag where wan_symbol=Frm_DWalutaKapitalu) as [@PaidInCapitalCurrencyId], frm_GUIDdane as [@CompanyAddressGUID], --as [@SubsidiaryAddressGUID], Frm_Telefon1 as [@CompanyPhoneNumber], --as [@SubsidiaryPhoneNumber], Frm_Fax as [@CompanyFax], --as [@SubsidiaryFax], Frm_Email as [@CompanyEmail], --as [@SubsidiaryEmail], 'true' as [@IsCurrent], Frm_URL as [@URL] from cdn.PicoStanowiska join cdn.PicoKonfig on PSa_PcKID = PcK_PicoID join cdn.FrmStruktura on FRS_ID = PcK_CentrumID join cdn.Firma on Frm_GidNumer = FRS_FrmNumer join cdn.KrajeCelne on Frm_Kraj = KPC_Kod LEFT JOIN CDN.WaLNag on Frm_DWalutaKapitalu = WaN_Symbol LEFT JOIN cdn.POS_WanDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0) on WaN_Id = WanID WHERE PSa_ID = @PointOfSaleId AND (Frm_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion OR @RowVersion = 0) AND (Frm_DWalutaKapitalu = '' OR WanID is not null) for xml path('Stamp'), type) for xml path('Stamps') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportPieczatki TO CDNRaport

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportTypyDokumentow] @RowVersion BIGINT, @PointOfSaleId INT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @dokumenty table(typ int) insert into @dokumenty values (2033),(2041),(2042),(8960),(2034) select (select MAX(Dok_CzasModyfikacji) from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.PicoStanowiska on pck_picoid = psa_pckid join cdn.dokdefinicje on Dok_FrsId = PcK_CentrumID where Dok_GIDTyp in (select * from @dokumenty) AND psa_id = @PointOfSaleId and (@RowVersion = 0 OR Dok_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion) ) as [@RowVersion], ( SELECT * FROM ( select 1 as [@Id], 5 as [@POSType], 2 as [@PricePrecision], 1 as [@NumeratorSchemeId], 'Wpłata kasowo-bankowa' as [@Name], 'True' as [@IsDefault]
union all
select 2 as [@Id], 6 as [@POSType], 2 as [@PricePrecision], 2 as [@NumeratorSchemeId], 'Wypłata kasowo-bankowa' as [@Name], 'True' as [@IsDefault]
union all
select 3 as [@Id], 18 as [@POSType], 2 as [@PricePrecision], 3 as [@NumeratorSchemeId], 'Nota debetowa' as [@Name], 'True' as [@IsDefault]
union all
select 4 as [@Id], 16 as [@POSType], 2 as [@PricePrecision], 4 as [@NumeratorSchemeId], 'Podsumowanie sesji' as [@Name], 'True' as [@IsDefault]
union all
select dok.dok_id as [@Id], case when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 2033 then 2 when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 2041 then 4 when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 2034 then 1 when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 2042 then 3 when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 9472 then 13 when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 1603 then 10 when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 1604 then 11 when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 8960 then 17 when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 1824 then 14 when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 1832 then 15 when dok.dok_GIDTyp = 3584 then 7 end as [@POSType], dok.dok_PrecyzjaCeny as [@PricePrecision], case when org.Dok_Id is not null then org.Dok_Id else dok.dok_id end as [@NumeratorSchemeId], dok.dok_Nazwa as [@Name], 'True' as [@IsDefault] from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.PicoStanowiska on pck_picoid = psa_pckid join cdn.dokdefinicje dok on dok.Dok_FrsId = PcK_CentrumID left join cdn.DokDefinicje org on dok.Dok_GIDTyp in (2041,2042) AND org.Dok_FrsId = dok.Dok_FrsId and org.Dok_GIDTyp = dok.Dok_GIDTyp - 8 where /*(isnull(org.Dok_WystPrawo,dok.dok_WystPrawo) = 1 OR dok.dok_GIDTyp = 8960) AND*/ dok.dok_GIDTyp in (select * from @dokumenty) AND psa_id = @PointOfSaleId and (@RowVersion = 0 OR dok.dok_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion) ) A for xml path('DocumentType'), type) for xml path('DocumentTypes') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportTypyDokumentow TO CDNRaport

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportTypyObiektowKlasAtrybutow] @RowVersion BIGINT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
declare @gidTypy Table(Typ int) insert into @gidTypy values(32) /*select (SELECT MAX(ato_czasModyfikacji) from cdn.AtrybutyObiekty where ato_gidtyp in(select * from @gidTypy)) as [@RowVersion], ( select AtO_Lp as [@Id], --DODAĆ ID IDENTITY AtO_AtKId as [@AttributeClassId], case when Ato_gidtyp=32 then 1 end as [@ObjectTypeId], case when AtK_Nieaktywny = 1 then 'false' else 'true' end as [@IsActive], case when AtK_Wymagany = 0 then 'false' else 'true' end as [@IsRequired] from ( Select AtO_GIDTyp,AtK_Nazwa,ATZ_Nazwa,AtO_Akcja,AtO_AtKID,AtO_Lp, (SELECT CASE WHEN AtO_Wymagany > -1 THEN AtO_Wymagany ELSE AtK_Wymagany END) as Atk_Wymagany, AtK_Nieaktywny, AtO_Online From Cdn.AtrybutyObiekty join Cdn.AtrybutyKlasy on AtO_AtKID = AtK_ID LEFT JOIN CDN.AtrybutyZrodla ON AtO_ATZID = ATZ_ID LEFT JOIN CDN.AtrybutyUprawnienia ON AtU_AtkID = AtK_ID Where AtK_Wielowart = 0 and AtO_Element=0 AND AtO_AtKID>0 AND (AtU_AtkID IS NULL OR ISNULL(AtU_OpeNumer,0) = 1) and AtK_NieAktywny = 0 AND AtO_GIDTyp in(select * from @gidTypy) and (AtO_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion or @RowVersion=0) /*Union Select AtO_GIDTyp,AkP_Nazwa,ATZ_Nazwa,AtO_Akcja, AtO_AtKID,AtO_Lp, 0, 0, AtO_Online From Cdn.AtrybutyObiekty join Cdn.AtrybutyKomplety on AtO_AtKID = -AkP_ID LEFT JOIN CDN.AtrybutyZrodla ON AtO_ATZID = ATZ_ID LEFT JOIN CDN.AtrybutyUprawnienia ON AtU_AtkID = -AkP_ID join cdn.AtrybutyKlasy on AtO_AtKId = atk_id Where AtK_Wielowart = 0 AND AtO_Element=0 and AtO_AtKID<0 AND (AtU_AtkID IS NULL OR ISNULL(AtU_OpeNumer,0) = 1) AND AtO_GIDTyp in(select * from @gidTypy) and (AtO_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion or @RowVersion=0)*/ ) a */ /* select 0 as [@RowVersion], ( select atk_id as [@Id], atk_id as [@AttributeClassId], 1 as [@ObjectTypeId], 'true' as [@IsActive], 'false' as [@IsRequired] */ select 0 as [@RowVersion], (select 1 WHERE 1=0 for xml path('AttributeClassObjectType'), type) for xml path('AttributeClassesObjectTypes') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportTypyObiektowKlasAtrybutow TO CDNRaport

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportWojewodztwa] AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; select 0 as [@RowVersion], ( select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ProvName ASC) as [@Id], x.ProvName as [@Name], (select isnull((select kpc_id from cdn.krajecelne where kpc_kod='pl'),0)) as [@CountryId], 'True' as [@IsActive] from ( select 'dolnośląskie' as ProvName union select 'kujawsko-pomorskie' union select 'lubelskie' union select 'lubuskie' union select 'łódzkie' union select 'małopolskie' union select 'mazowieckie' union select 'opolskie' union select 'podkarpackie' union select 'podlaskie' union select 'pomorskie' union select 'śląskie' union select 'świętokrzyskie' union select 'warmińsko-mazurskie' union select 'wielkopolskie' union select 'zachodniopomorskie'
) x for xml path('Province'), type) for xml path('Provinces') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportWojewodztwa TO CDNRaport
